reader.notes: WiseOwl specifies no implementor-name for the clause (docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-150.md: 'Not provided'), and a name written anyway draws COBOL1778 and the default framing. At 85 the 2023 A.1 'optional' ground does not exist; the ground here is that the implementor-name set is the implementor's and is documented empty, and the warning is the 1985 extension flag (§1985:I.1.5.2.5.2). Verdict by the kb/Work PB5373 class-3 decision, as for GR6. A stricter reading would refuse an undefined implementor-name as a non-word; accepting it inert with a named warning changes nothing a program can observe (GR1).
